where: so it guessed one; parsed.errors was nonempty and readColumnCsv threw COLUMN_CSV_LIMIT_OR_INVALID,
signature: Papa error {type: Delimiter, code: UndetectableDelimiter}. The guess needs more than 1.99 fields per line
on average over the first 10 lines, and the empty line after a final line ending counts as a one-field
line. So a 2-column table of at most 8 records fails, and a 1-column table always fails.
why_tj1_and_not_reh9: TJ1's register has 2 columns and 2 records: with the final newline the average is 5/3.
The NYC register has many records, so its first 10 lines hold no empty line.
second_defect: column-profile.ts:373 (base) bounded raw records, blank ones included, to maxRows + 1: a table of exactly
2,000 records with a final line ending, or with a blank line between records, was refused.

record; an empty cell stays empty text; a row longer than the header is refused.

record, empty cells, quoted line endings, header only. The whole read, the stream read and the stream read
one byte at a time give the same records, source rows and row hashes (SHA-256 of the cells).
